name: Tsumagoi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tsumagoi village emblem in green: an outlined four-lobed device enclosing a ring with a stylised character, with the characters 嬬恋村 below.
history: Municipal flag of Tsumagoi, a village in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 6 October 1950.
